commit_message: Add ADR 0125 VFX CPU reference runtime
pr_body: Implements ADR 0125 in staged commits. Adds the CPU reference VFX instance consuming backend-neutral IR, deterministic random channels, ordered spawn/update semantics, burst/rate emission, authored budget/drop counters, fixed-step preview replay, stable-ID reconfiguration, and shape-directed InitialSpeed needed for the simple ParticleEmitter adapter. The existing authoring/service stage remains in this Draft PR; simple-emitter/renderer/player/Builder integration follows.
